\n<Kurt> \fi A water jug. Old, unglazed clay. The kind
in museum exhibits with little plaques that say
'circa 1800s.'
\n<Kurt> \fi Except this one is being used.This morning.
Today. Whatever today is.
\n<Kurt> \fi Woven bamboo. No concrete. No glass in the
windows — just wooden shutters. The whole house is
built from what was growing around it.
\n<Kurt> \fi There's something almost beautiful about
that, and I hate that I'm noticing it right now,
because it means I'm accepting this is real.

\n<Florante> Sa bayan. May itatanong lang kami.
